name: iRobot Roomba i7+
title: iRobot Roomba i7+ Replacement Parts: Filters, Brushes & Clean Base Bags | DustMigo
description: Find genuine Roomba i7+ replacement filters, dual rubber brushes, edge-sweeping brushes and Clean Base bags. Check the exact fit, pack contents and care intervals before ordering.
scope: Choose a replacement filter, roller brush kit, side brush or Clean Base bag for the iRobot Roomba i7+. Parts for the robot and bags for its self-emptying dock are listed separately.
warning: This guide covers the vacuum-only Roomba i7+ with Clean Base. A standard Roomba i7 may use the same robot consumables, but it does not need a Clean Base bag unless you have that dock. The Combo j7+ and Combo j9+ are different models; iRobot excludes them from its standard e/i/j refill kit.

compatibility.detail: The i7 and i7+ share i-series robot consumables covered by iRobot's e/i/j refill kit. The plus package includes a Clean Base; only buy dock bags if your setup has that base.

compatibility.part: Robot parts vs. Clean Base bags
compatibility.detail: Filters, dual rubber brushes and edge-sweeping brushes install on the robot. Dirt-disposal bags install in the Clean Base dock. A matching bag does not establish fit for any robot part.

Combo j7+ and Combo j9+ are separate vacuum-and-mop robots. iRobot explicitly excludes them from its standard e/i/j refill kit; do not infer compatibility from shared series wording or a shared dock bag.

The four linked consumable listings are iRobot-branded parts. The refill-kit listing bundles rollers, filters and side brushes; the other cards provide individual filter, side-brush and Clean Base bag options.

careTip: Roomba e/i/j filters are not washable: tap off debris and keep them dry. Before replacing the dual rubber brushes, remove wrapped hair from the rollers and their end caps. If the Clean Base signals a bag problem, check that the bag is present and seated correctly before replacing it.

questions.question: Do Roomba i7 and i7+ use the same replacement parts?
questions.answer: The robot consumables in iRobot's e/i/j refill kit cover i-series models including i7+. The i7+ package also includes a Clean Base, so it uses a disposable dock bag; a standard i7 only needs one if you bought that dock separately.

questions.question: Will this Roomba i7+ kit fit Combo j7+ or Combo j9+?
questions.answer: No. iRobot explicitly says its standard e/i/j replenishment kit is not compatible with Combo j7+ or Combo j9+. Use a Combo-specific listing and verify each item rather than relying on the shared j-series name.

questions.question: How often should I replace Roomba i7+ filters and brushes?
questions.answer: iRobot recommends replacing the filter every 2 months and the dual rubber brushes every 6–12 months. Clean the filter weekly and the brushes weekly, or twice weekly in a home with pets. Clean the edge brush monthly and replace it when worn or damaged.

questions.question: Are these genuine iRobot replacement parts?
questions.answer: Yes. The filter, roller-brush refill kit, side brushes and Clean Base bags are iRobot-branded listings. Compare the part number and selected pack on Amazon before ordering because listing details and variations can change.

questions.question: Is the original Roomba i7+ robot listing available?
questions.answer: The exact Amazon listing shown here was marked unavailable when checked on October 7, 2026. Amazon availability can change, so confirm the model and Clean Base configuration on the live listing or a current replacement listing.
